revision: P2-B batch 2 (supersedes the closeout file where different)
note: Parameters that produced the delivered kit and preview. Each has a measured reason in the closeout documents; change one with a measurement.

kit_export.baked_colour: Hue/Saturation grade and flat cloth tints baked into base textures in linear space; export aborts if a baked material loses its base-colour link

metals_constants.applies_to: non-MI_ materials without an ORM map

module_lod.method: collapse decimate on the template before archetypes are built; --no-lod disables

vertex_ao.note: 0.9/0.2 clamped 56 % of vertices at the floor; 0.4/0.3 clamps 0.8 % and looks the same at mix 0.8

glb.merge: one mesh per archetype per material

kit_export.texture_reuse: byte-identical baked images share one image datablock (82 -> 69 GLB images)
kit_export.vertex_colour: every Color Attribute node points at the layer "Color" (else the exporter drops COLOR_0)
kit_export.signs: signs and banners are placed SIGN_* nodes, one per (asset, scale); building nodes carry none

preview_look.tone_mapping: Khronos PBR Neutral injected per material (renderer.toneMapping = 0); exposure 0.75

sun.frustum: fitted to the built area in light space (fitSunShadow)

collision_and_camera.open_arcade_roof: two-slope shell of thin camera-only boxes, space below free; outermost 0.83 m eave step not a camera obstacle
collision_and_camera.merchandise_footprints: measured bounding boxes of the source models (load_dims), floor-standing items above 0.12 m high and 0.25 m wide
collision_and_camera.network_node_rule: aisle and passage nodes at the centre of the free span measured on collision proxies

network.node_rule: centre of the free span measured on collision proxies
network.via_rule: edges within 0.5 m of a solid get via-points

loader_todo_p2b: merge per ~30 m cell instead of per district
drop original meshes after merging (357 geometries -> merged only)
mesh quantisation (KHR_mesh_quantization, COLOR_0 as normalised bytes) to cut the raw GLB by about 40 %
distance LOD for roofs/props only if the town view exceeds budget

loader.prewarm: render with shadows on/off/on, culling disabled, before first frame (~630 ms)
loader.merge: mergeByGroup per district (production default) or scene (comparison); cell-sized groups recommended for the town
